abstract: The conventional treatments given to a 24-year-old woman with metastatic uterine choriocarcinoma and clinical and biochemical thyrotoxicosis did not appear to have any effect, probably due to an extremely high serum human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level which was up to 11,910,000 mIU/mL, and were initially underscored in light of the 'high-dose hook effect'. To our knowledge, no extremely high hCG level in a uterine choriocarcinoma patient has been reported in the literature. Her decapacitating symptoms subsided after the first course of chemotherapy by etoposide, methotrexate, and actinomycin D-cyclophosphamide and vincristine (EMA-CO) regimen. The serum hCG level, which reflects the quantification of host tumor burden, returned to the reference range after the fifth course of chemotherapy and the thyroid function reached euthyroid status before the third course of chemotherapy; two final courses were administered after the hCG level became undetectable. Two years after remission of disease, the patient experienced a normal pregnancy, and a term baby girl was delivered vaginally. No recurrence of uterine choriocarcinoma has been noted for 7 years.
abstract_ja: 24歳の女性で転移性子宮絨毛癌および臨床的・生化学的な甲状腺中毒症を認めた症例に対する従来の治療は、極めて高い血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値(最大11,910,000 mIU/mL)により効果がなかったと考えられ、当初は「高用量フック効果」の可能性を考慮して過小評価されていました。我々の知る限り、子宮絨毛癌患者で極めて高いヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が報告された例はありません。エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンによるEMA-CO化学療法の初回投与後、患者の衰弱させるほどの症状は軽快しました。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値は第5コースの化学療法後に基準範囲内に戻り、甲状腺機能は第3コースの化学療法前に正常化しました。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が検出されなくなった後に、最後の2コースが投与されました。寛解から2年後、患者は正常妊娠を経験し、正常な女児を正期産で経膣分娩しました。7年間、子宮絨毛癌の再発は認められていません。
